prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph, shot on cheap expired colour film at night: a bare British parish hall, worn wooden floor with faded painted badminton lines, tall black windows. A ring of mismatched stacking chairs (orange plastic, old wooden, one folding metal) stands in the middle of the floor. Small children in paper party hats circle the ring mid-step, seen only from behind, slightly blurred with motion. On a trestle table at the edge, a cassette player with its lid open and a paper plate of half-eaten sandwiches. A single fluorescent tube overhead throws a cold teal light; the hall corners fall into darkness. Heavy grain, lonely, faintly eerie. Low camera at a child's hip height. Thanks.
